articles.title: U.S. Weekly Jobless Claims Unexpectedly Edge Slightly Lower
articles.expand: The Labor Department released a report on Thursday unexpectedly showing a slight dip in first-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits in the week ended October 24th. The report said initial jobless claims edged down to 194,000, a decrease of 1,000 from the previous week's revised level of 195,000. Economists had expected jobless claims to rise to rise to 199,000.
